invariants.rationale: Option is expected to never be null by convention.
A metadata writer is present only if the system is not a metadata table and the configuration/availability and existence checks pass.
The result is Option.of(metadataWriter) or Option.empty() depending on the state of configuration and availability.
If result is empty, it can be because it is a metadata table (early exit).
The flag autoDetectAndDeleteMetadataPartitions is only used to trigger optional logic and does not affect the presence of result directly.
